pathology.rule: Pathology labels/outcomes are a separate protected information channel. Opening expression or latent states for a donor never authorizes pathology access.

dev_sealed.rule: Foundation development, foundation/continuation sealed_holdout, reader_oracle, and whole-study external holdout stay closed unless a named prospective release authority explicitly opens them for a predeclared purpose.

allowed_now: D1-A synthetic/u0-safe development when no real reader-fit expression is consumed
future_eligible_uses: healthy-teacher training corpus after separate frozen training contract
D1 real discovery after mechanically healthy trained teacher and D1 algorithm freeze
real F1-A producer after producer/replay source freeze and separate execution authority

reader_validation.intended_role: reader/model selection and descriptive validation only after prospective release
never_allowed: post-outcome tuning folded back into reader_fit training

release_requires: reader-validation phase concluded without further tuning
reader_oracle.consequence_of_opening: Once opened for a candidate, those outcomes become historical evaluation evidence and cannot be reused as an untouched oracle for a modified candidate.

foundation_development.intended_role: separate future development/validation population, not implicitly interchangeable with reader_validation
release_requires: frozen analysis code and outputs permitted
explicit statement whether results may influence model selection
confirmatory analysis source and multiplicity plan frozen

foundation_train_without_reader_partitio.rule: These donors are train in the foundation registry but are not part of the frozen 149-donor reader split. They must not be silently added to the healthy-teacher corpus; any inclusion needs a new corpus-extension authority.

f1a.current_status: producer/replay source layer still unbuilt; real sweep unauthorized

f1b_c3.current_status: mechanics successor under integration/external-review preparation; no training authority

t0.current_status: V20 independently reviewed execution binding; real T0/pathology still unauthorized

forbidden_shortcuts: Treating foundation development as equivalent to reader_validation
Treating reader_oracle as equivalent to foundation sealed_holdout
Treating a donor's expression access as permission to access pathology
Using any oracle/sealed result to tune training, D1 ranking rules, or confirmatory thresholds
Silently adding continuation/train donors to the historical reader-fit teacher-training pool
Opening a protected population because code is mechanically ready

historical_exposure.note: Historical T1 calibration/evaluation opened reader_validation and reader_oracle under the frozen T1 biology-evaluation plan. That historical exposure does not grant current or future access authority. Because u10-u205 are defect-inherited, those uses remain historical evidence only.
